final: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), above_avg AS (SELECT sa.station_avg, oa.overall_avg FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_avg > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(station_avg) as mean_usage_above_avg, AVG(station_avg - overall_avg) as mean_excess_above_avg FROM above_avg
